message.content:
Implement a feature on the Nxeon platform (Next.js App Router + TS + Prisma + Tailwind). Work ONLY inside your worktree **/opt/nxeon-wt-idea-deploywiz/** (full repo copy, node_modules + .env symlinked). ALL edits use absolute paths under that dir; NEVER edit /opt/nxeon. `cd /opt/nxeon-wt-idea-deploywiz` for shell. Verify `npx tsc --noEmit`, fix type errors. Do NOT build/deploy/restart.

CARD — "Game server deploy wizard": the current game-selection step is a cluttered mess. Redo it cleanly + premium. First Read the design ref: /opt/nxeon/board-uploads/board/cmsvfdn1g001nhl1ss1jvr19t/9070bbe9a32ffc1579fa10cd.png

REQUIREMENTS: (1) display all games cleanly — spacious, well-organized grid/sections; (2) fetch/show ACTUAL game posters (cover art) per game with graceful fallback; (3) add a SEARCH BAR to filter games (+ optional category/sort). Premium Nxeon look (dark navy/black + electric blue/purple gradients, glass, thin borders, restrained neon). Keep the wizard flow working — selecting a game continues to plan/config/checkout.

FIRST explore: find the EXISTING game deploy/order wizard (grep "deploy wizard", game category, the order flow, os templates with game slugs, `db.gamePlan`, the game-logo/poster drop-in convention). Upgrade the game-picker step IN PLACE; preserve downstream order/checkout wiring. Only stub poster fetching if there's genuinely no source (note it).

SCOPE (siblings run in parallel): ONLY the deploy/order wizard game-selection UI. Do NOT touch the per-server management panel, the marketing carousel, pricing, or landing pages.

RETURN (final text = DATA): (1) files changed, 1 line each; (2) poster source / stubs; (3) how to test (route + steps); (4) follow-ups. No preamble.

- No stub needed — real poster fetching already exists via the owner drop-in convention in `GameCoverTile.tsx` (reused unchanged): `public/logos/games/covers/<family>.{webp,jpg,png}` → `public/logos/games/<family>.png` wordmark → per-game gradient+glyph.

- Prices/tier counts/Popular flags are all read live from the `gamePlan` tiers already passed in — nothing invented.

- Route: `/dashboard/deploy` (auth required), then click the **Game Servers** product card (or `/dashboard/deploy?product=game`). Same wizard also renders at `/dashboard/games`.
- Steps: on Step 1 "Game" — type in the search bar (filters by name, e.g. "min", "forest"); click category pills (Survival / Sandbox / Shooter / Building / All); change Sort (Popular first / Name A–Z / Price low→high); clear the query to see the empty-state "Clear filters". - Only 6/19 games have real cover art; owner should drop the remaining 13 key-art files into `public/logos/games/covers/` for full visual parity (siblings/marketing carousel benefit too).
- `GAME_GENRE` is a hardcoded presentation-only map in the component; if games become dynamic/DB-driven, consider moving genre onto the `gamePlan`/`osTemplate` model.
